title: Home practical guide and safety card: lung volume bottle
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: The periodic table (8F); breathing and respiration (8C)
source: Written for science/y8 lesson 36 (Home practical guide and safety card: lung volume bottle (portal worksheet; own straw, sit down, stop if dizzy))
intro: Lesson 36: Measuring lung volume. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

equipment: Your own bendy straw or tube
safety: Own straw, sit down, stop if dizzy
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Fill the bottle and bowl with water
Turn the bottle upside down in the bowl without letting air in
Sit down; put your own straw into the bottle
Take a deep breath and breathe out once into the straw
Mark the water level; stop if dizzy
Measure the air volume with a jug afterwards

questions.a: The most air breathed out after a deep breath
options: The most air breathed out after a deep breath

questions.q: Big question: how could you test swimmers' lungs fairly?
questions.a: Measure many swimmers and non-swimmers the same way and compare means.
